title: The Arm of God
source_location: Complete 16-page inspection; especially printed pp.5-14: reciprocal law, flat-to-sphere projection, 1.5-turn trim, three 120-degree projections, 49/99 tetrahedra, sphere-pack and First Hand illustrations
equations_present: yes: r*theta=1; no complete 3-D self-embedding equation
construction_steps_present: yes for reciprocal/spherical scaffold; no deterministic final shaping step
continuous_free_parameters_remain: yes for final 3-D shaping / carrier deformation
key_evidence: The document promises a simple, meaningful, well-defined construction and then specifies r*theta=1, projection onto a cube-octahedral sphere, a finite inner endpoint exactly 1.5 turns (3*pi) from the outer end, and three copies spaced 120 degrees. Later pages add the 49/99 tetrahedral and sphere-pack scaffold. Across the complete 16-page document, no textual derivation or instruction for endpoint parallelism, self-embedment, or bending is given. The promised well-defined construction therefore reaches the reciprocal/spherical scaffold but not a uniquely defined finished endpoint-parallel FIRST HAND deformation.
follow_up: Treat Arm of God construction inspection as complete. Follow its explicit pointer to The Dirac String Trick - First Hand and continue search for the missing algebraic/geometric shaping rule in other registered Tier-A sources.

key_evidence: The 3,10 row explicitly gives Total Helix Turns = 3, Total Tetrahedra = 99, and HANDS (1 1/2-T) = 6.
